Blog post from this, ~600 words. Audience is people who've just started
running a small team for the first time — they're anxious and they read
too much advice.

Title: The meeting you should cancel first
Rough shape I had in mind:
  - the recurring status meeting nobody will admit is dead
  - why it survives (everyone assumes someone else needs it)
  - what to do instead, concretely
  - the one case where you should keep it

Don't need it to follow that order if something better falls out.
